title.zh: 交易员很快将能押注 Coinbase、Robinhood 和 Marathon 是否达标
title.en: Traders will soon be able to bet on whether Coinbase, Robinhood and Marathon will hit their targets

current_state.zh:
SEC 在 10 月 13 日的声明中批准了 Cboe Global Markets 提交的规则变更，允许上线与 23 家美国上市公司关键业绩指标（KPI）挂钩的二元期权，涉及 Coinbase 的交易量、Robinhood 的客户数与营收，以及 MARA Holdings 的比特币产量。Cboe 计划本月挂牌这些合约，Robinhood 预计将成为首家向散户提供该产品的券商。

据 Crypto America 主持人 Eleanor Terrett 在 X 上的说法，这为交易加密相关公司的业绩表现提供了新方式，而不必直接押注比特币价格；SEC 批准的是这一特定的证券期权结构，结构不同的合约仍可归美国商品期货交易委员会（CFTC）管辖。

这些合约为现金结算、欧式行权，只能在到期时行权，并将按公司 SEC 申报文件中的数字结算，而非财报演示文稿中的数据。SEC 主席 Paul Atkins 表示，此次批准不涉及由 CFTC 监管的类似合约，例如预测市场平台 Kalshi 上的合约。
current_state.en: The SEC approved the listing of binary options tied to key performance indicators of 23 U.S.-listed companies, including Coinbase trading volume, Robinhood customer and revenue metrics, and MARA bitcoin production, creating a new way to trade crypto-linked company performance.

updates.detailed_summary_en: The SEC approved the listing of binary options tied to key performance indicators of 23 U.S.-listed companies, including Coinbase trading volume, Robinhood customer and revenue metrics, and MARA bitcoin production, creating a new way to trade crypto-linked company performance.
updates.background_zh: Cboe Global Markets 此前已向 SEC 申请批准与公司业绩指标挂钩的二元 KPI 期权。二元期权是一种衍生品合约，交易者对某个“是或否”的命题下注，命题成立即可获得固定赔付，此类产品在许多司法辖区被禁止向散户销售。证券期权由 SEC 监管，而 CFTC 负责期货和大宗商品期权，这一分工可追溯至 1974 年 CFTC 的设立。
updates.background_en: Cboe Global Markets had sought SEC approval for binary KPI options tied to company metrics. A binary option is a derivative contract that pays a fixed amount depending on whether a yes-or-no proposition resolves true, and such products are banned for retail customers in many jurisdictions. Oversight of securities options sits with the SEC, while the CFTC regulates futures and commodity options, a split dating to the CFTC's creation in 1974.
updates.market_impact_zh: 这些合约为交易者提供了在受监管交易所、以现金结算方式对加密公司经营指标（Coinbase 交易量、Robinhood 客户与营收数据、MARA 的比特币产量）表达看法的工具，而非直接押注 BTC 价格，散户渠道初期预计主要通过 Robinhood。交易需等待清算机构 Cboe Clear U.S. 获得临时注册后方可开始，该独立申请目前仍在审理中。
updates.market_impact_en: The contracts give traders a listed, cash-settled venue to express views on crypto-company operational metrics — Coinbase trading volume, Robinhood customer and revenue figures, and MARA's bitcoin production — rather than on the BTC price itself, with retail distribution initially expected through Robinhood. Trading cannot begin until clearing house Cboe Clear U.S. receives provisional registration, a separate application that is still pending.
